source.title: The Fabaceae in Northeastern Mexico (Subfamily Papilionoideae, Tribes Amorpheae, Brongniartieae, and Dalbergieae)

provenance_note: New research record; preserves preexisting source extracts, species JSON, photographic files, licenses and attribution; no learner scoring or public site changes.
gap_addressed: Existing monograph summary flags unreviewed infraspecific variability; 2025 regional study supplies a differential key for three varieties.
source_treatment_location: Dalea identification key couplets 6–8 and three varietal treatments near web lines 633–654

var_neomexicana.leaflet_margin: Strongly undulate because of submarginal glands
var_neomexicana.flower_colors: Bicolored white and crimson or lilac

var_longipila.flower_colors: Bicolored white and crimson or lilac

var_megaladenia.adaxial_pubescence: Upper leaflet surface glabrous or hairy only at margins

reconciliation: 2025 key corroborates why earlier Barneby monograph cautioned variability. Do not assign measurements specific to one variety to an undifferentiated D. neomexicana specimen.
source_limitation: Regional treatment covers northeastern Mexican varieties and supplies varietal differentials; this does not identify the variety of project photographs or prove all varieties occur in Hays County.
integration_flag: Replace any absolute 'purple-violet only' learner criterion with source-attributed bicolored corolla possibility; exact variety remains unresolved
